g.text: Gap: spec §6.4 also lists auditor changes and late filings; not implemented.

text.tspan: survivor metrics
value = highest passing value indicator score
quality = (ROIC − sector WACC) + ROE; a missing ROE counts 0
growth = revenue compound annual growth rate (CAGR) = (last ÷ first)^(1 ÷ (years − 1)) − 1
growth = 0 when fewer than 2 years or first ≤ 0
percentile of each metric over all survivors
percentile = rank among distinct values ÷ (distinct values − 1)
ties share a percentile
one survivor or all values equal: 1.0

g.text: score = 100 × (0.40 × value + 0.30 × quality + 0.20 × growth + 0.10 × margin of safety)

g.text: Gap: ROIC tax falls back to the US 21% whenever the country has no Damodaran tax rate (or one outside [0, 1)), not to a rate of that country.

terms: return on equity (ROE), earnings per share (EPS), book value (BV), enterprise value (EV), earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT), earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA).
net debt = total debt − cash; a missing term counts as 0; both missing: empty
P/E = close ÷ EPS, only when EPS > 0
BV per share = total equity ÷ diluted shares
P/BV = close ÷ BV per share, only when > 0
EV ÷ EBITDA = (market cap + net debt) ÷ EBITDA
ROIC = EBIT × (1 − tax) ÷ (total debt + total equity); a missing term counts as 0; both missing: empty
free cash flow yield = free cash flow ÷ market cap
operating margin = EBIT ÷ revenue, per year
Histories (revenue, operating cash flow, diluted shares, operating margin) drop empty years.
Otherwise a missing input leaves the ratio empty.
Every layer still runs on a failing company, so its failed rules are all recorded.
Gap: spec §6.4 exempts dilution from justified mergers and acquisitions; the code caps growth unconditionally.
Gap: spec §6.5 puts margin stability in the quality score and free cash flow growth in the growth score; the code uses (ROIC − WACC) + ROE and revenue CAGR only.
Each weight is in [0, 1] and the four sum to 1; otherwise the preset fails to load.
The margin of safety is the raw intrinsic value ÷ price, not a percentile, so the score has no ceiling at 100.
Survivors cut by --top are not written.
